page_title: ELC 2-1 MAL | Elche v Mallorca 21/03/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+13' Javier Alberola is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.

90+10' Leo Petrot (Elche) spurned a good chance! He gets a shot away from inside the penalty box, but it goes inches wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mallorca.
90+7' Javier Alberola shows the yellow card to Leo Petrot (Elche) for a heavy challenge.
90+5' Here is a change. German Valera is going off and Eder Sarabia gives the last tactical orders to Adria Pedrosa (Elche).
90+5' Here comes a substitution. Leo Petrot (Elche) is brought on as a substitute for Alvaro Rodriguez.
90+4' Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) gets a yellow card, off the field.
90+3' The expression of the referee Javier Alberola is crystal clear. This behaviour won't be tolerated. Antonio Raillo (Mallorca) is shown a yellow card.
90+2' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) fails to beat the goalkeeper from the penalty spot.
90+2' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
90' We will have 8 min. of added time.
90' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Mallorca!
90' There's a break in play and referee Javier Alberola must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Mallorca using VAR. This could be interesting!
90' Surely that's handball by one of the Elche players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
89' German Valera (Elche) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
89' Substitution. Antonio Sanchez makes his way off the pitch and Justin-Noel Kalumba (Mallorca) comes on as his replacement.
88' Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
85' Great teamplay by Mallorca as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
82' Toni Lato (Mallorca) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Javier Alberola didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
80' Eder Sarabia prepares a substitution. Rafa Mir is replaced by Buba Sangare (Elche).
79' Substitution. Marc Aguado will be replaced by Federico Redondo Solari (Elche).

78' Samu Costa (Mallorca) misses a good chance to score. A perfect cross into the box finds Samu Costa (Mallorca) who rises for a header, but he sends the ball well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Elche.
77' Marc Aguado (Elche) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
76' Neat passing move from Mallorca in order to create new attacking opportunities.

71' 2 - 1 German Valera showcases his great technique and produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box. Tete Morente (Elche) meets the cross and gets himself onto the scoresheet with a header into the bottom left corner. It's 2:1.
65' It's time for a substitution. Sergi Darder (Mallorca) comes on in place of Pablo Torre.
65' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Zito Luvumbo walks off the pitch to be replaced by Manu Morlanes (Mallorca).
64' Eder Sarabia decides to make a substitution. Grady Diangana will be replaced by Gonzalo Villar (Elche).
64' Javier Alberola sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
63' Wait! Referee Javier Alberola has indicated he is going to review the Elche goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
62' 1 - 1 One of the defending players stopped the first attempt, but the ball lands at the feet of Rafa Mir (Elche) and he unleashes a shot which goes in off the bottom of the left post.
58' 0 - 1 Goal! Great play by Zito Luvumbo releases Pablo Torre (Mallorca) in space on the edge of the box. He spots the keeper off his line and coolly puts the ball into bottom right corner. 0:1.
55' Samu Costa (Mallorca) goes on a mazy run through the defence and gets within shooting range inside the box, but his effort to the bottom right corner is thwarted by Matias Dituro.
53' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Elche.
51' Tete Morente (Elche) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.

50' Grady Diangana (Elche) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Javier Alberola with no other option than to blow for a foul.
48' Mallorca exchange some short passes over a small area and control the game. Now they make a mistake and lose the ball and the whole situation changes completely.
46' The Elche players are exchanging some short passes.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
43' It's a nice effort by Pedro Bigas (Elche) from the edge of the box, but it's low towards the middle of the goal and straight down the throat of Leo Roman. Easy save.
42' The Elche players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
40' Mateo Joseph (Mallorca) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
38' Antonio Raillo (Mallorca) is clearly in an offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
38' Mallorca have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
37' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) attempts to release Zito Luvumbo with a through ball, but his effort is thwarted by one of the defending players.
37' Mallorca enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
34' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) has to stretch for the ball in the box and sends it just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Elche.
32' A lofted cross from Zito Luvumbo (Mallorca) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
32' Mallorca seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
29' Victor Chust (Elche) picks up a yellow card for a foul.
28' Pablo Torre (Mallorca) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.

24' What a big chance! Alvaro Rodriguez (Elche) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball a whisker wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Mallorca will have a goal kick.
22' Mallorca are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
21' Aleix Febas (Elche) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.
20' Matias Dituro (Elche) and Victor Chust matched up again to find some space for an unmarked teammate.
18' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 60:40.

17' The Elche players are exchanging some short passes and control the game at the moment, but one of the defending players steps in and intercepts the ball. The ball is out of play. Elche will take a throw-in.
13' Tete Morente (Elche) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
10' Mallorca control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
9' Matias Dituro (Elche) crosses the ball forward but it is intercepted.
6' Great teamplay by Elche as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.

4' Zito Luvumbo (Mallorca) had a good chance to change the score. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a shot from just outside the penalty area which went towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper was ready and made an amazing save.
3' Mallorca are passing the ball across the pitch and keep possession. However, an opponent intercepts a pass and the situation changes. The ball is out of play. Mallorca will have a throw-in.
2' The Elche players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
1' Mallorca quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Mallorca will take the kick-off.
Javier Alberola is the one to supervise the game today.
